label: v3-student-1-c1-webrefs
pipeline: V3/compose case 3 (a specific thing; the reference supplied by hand, the state manager assumed perfect)
brief: One clip, 15 seconds, widescreen, no dialogue. Five pictures are attached and are the references: student-teacher.jpg is the TEACHER (the man in the grey long-sleeve shirt), web-evan.jpg is EVAN (the young man with braids), web-maya.jpg is MAYA (the young woman with the fringe; ignore the umbrella and the studio props, she is a student at a desk here), web-leo.jpg is LEO (the young man in the old black-and-white portrait; render him in colour, as a present-day student in casual clothes, keeping his face and hair), and student-classroom.jpg is the CLASSROOM (the scene must be this room: these desks, these windows, this green board). Each person must look exactly like their picture. The scene: in that classroom, the teacher walks along the row and hands Evan his returned test; Evan turns it over and the score '38/100' is clear; Maya, at the next desk, leans over and points at the score; Leo looks, smirks and nudges Maya; she covers a mocking grin; Evan lowers his eyes and pulls the paper toward himself, his hand covering the score at the end. Morning light from the windows.

tools.prompt: Create a 15-second silent classroom drama about a returned test, widescreen 16:9, inside @classroom, matching its wooden desks, grid windows, green lockers and green chalkboard. Photorealistic colour, soft morning window light, restrained performances and an uncomfortable mood. Five coherent shots preserve reference likenesses, clothing, desk positions and one test paper throughout; use the images as identity and setting references, not pasted photographs. 0–3 seconds: medium two-shot, @teacher, light-skinned with short wavy brown hair, faint stubble, grey long-sleeved shirt and blue jeans, hands a face-down white test paper to seated @evan, with short black twists, silver necklaces and a black sweatshirt with white scribbles and red patches; wooden desks line the aisle, gentle lateral slide; @evan now holds the paper and @teacher's hands are empty. 3–6 seconds: over-shoulder close-up, @evan turns the test face-up on the wooden desktop; its large handwritten score reads exactly '38/100', unobstructed and legible, slow push in. 6–9 seconds: medium close-up, @maya, brown hair with bangs, white ruffled blouse and black vest, already leaning from the next desk, points at the score with a teasing expression; the green board is softly visible behind, gentle lateral slide. 9–12 seconds: medium two-shot, @leo, clean-shaven with swept-back wavy hair and the reference face, rendered in natural colour wearing a modern charcoal sweatshirt, nudges @maya with his elbow, a smug smirk on his face; adjacent wooden desks remain visible, slow push in. 12–15 seconds: wider establishing view of the three adjacent desks, @evan sits with downcast eyes, the paper close against his body and his palm completely obscuring the score; @maya's hand rests over a mocking grin, @leo remains smirking. Hold this still, readable tableau for all three seconds. Natural colour grade, measured pacing. No audio, subtitles, text overlays, umbrella or studio props.
